description: This file defines a PHP class 'LeaveEventSubscriber' which subscribes to leave-related events in the OrangeHRM system, handling email notifications for leave applications, assignments, approvals, cancellations, and rejections. It manages event subscriptions, email service initialization, and event handling logic with role-based notifications.

classes.name: LeaveEventSubscriber
classes.description: Handles subscription and processing of leave-related events to send email notifications based on leave actions.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping leave events to corresponding handler methods for subscription.

methods.name: getEmailService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of EmailService.

methods.name: onAllocateEvent
methods.description: Handles leave allocation events, sending notification emails depending on the specific event type (apply or assign).

methods.name: onStatusChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles leave status change events (approve, cancel, reject), triggering notification emails accordingly.
